_comment: Two-channel decoupled, SHARED pilot slot: BS(.21) rx=AB (ch0=ADC_D, ch1=ADC_C); UE(.22) tx=AB fires BOTH pilots in slot 2. Cables are spatially orthogonal (.22 DAC_B->.21 ADC_D=ch0, .22 DAC_A->.21 ADC_C=ch1) so the BS separates the two links in space -- no time-orthogonal slots needed; each RX antenna gets one clean pilot.
_ue_tdd_pilot_note: UE streams its pilot with the tdd=1 TX stream arg -> the driver TxTickAnchor accepts the beacon-referenced start on the 3.125us TDD window grid (SH-248/SH-301), not whole-ms, so no 1ms drift-cliff. ue_tx_advance_ticks is QUANTIZED to the 384-tick anchor grid (values under 192 vanish; leave 0). Fine seating comes from the zero-padded burst; tx_advance=247 is the bench calibration (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.48).
_bs_hw_framer_note: true selects the BS native-Houdini-TDD framer path: beacon replay strobe + one rx_gate window per sounder pilot slot; loopRecv's HW-framer true-path receives only those, tagged with the sounder slot. The TDD symbol is a fixed 0.5ms (decoupled from the slot) so the capture fits inside the rx_gate window; samps_per_slot just needs to be <= 4096 (FPGA TX_RAM, else genPilots' size_t remain_size underflows). 48*80 + 128+128 = 4096.
_corr_scale_init_note: Acquisition-only detection threshold. The test is corr_scale * peak > local_energy, so a SMALLER value is STRICTER. Measured on this link: windows with no beacon peak at a ratio of 3.4e-07, windows with a beacon at 0.31 to 4.2 (median 2.8). corr_scale 100 puts the bar at 0.01, far below anything real, so sidelobes crossed first and the earliest crossing won. 10 puts it at 0.1, inside the empty gap between the two populations, keeping every real beacon with 3x margin. Re-sync still uses corr_scale and still relaxes per retry. NOTE this did NOT fix the run-to-run constellation split it was investigated for; that fault is downstream, in the U-slot data subcarriers, not in beacon acquisition.
